supplier.name: supplier
supplier.description: Used for managing supplier information and relationships
examples: Find suppliers in a specific city

supplier_items.name: supplier_items
supplier_items.description: Used for managing items associated with suppliers
examples: View items from a specific supplier

item_category.name: item_category
item_category.description: Used for categorizing and organizing items
examples: Find items in a specific category

item_master.name: item_master
item_master.description: Used for managing product and item information

purchase_requisition.name: purchase_requisition
purchase_requisition.description: Used for managing purchase requests and approvals. You can add items to a purchase requisition using the 'item' junction model. To add products, first search for them in the 'item_master' model, then add them to a purchase requisition by creating 'item' records that link the purchase requisition and the selected products.
examples: Add products to a purchase requisition by searching in item_master and linking them via item
Assign multiple items to a purchase requisition using the item model

item.name: item
item.description: Used for managing individual items in purchase requisitions. This is a junction model that links products from item_master to purchase requisitions. To add a product to a purchase requisition, create an item record with the appropriate purchase requisition and product references.
examples: Add items to a purchase requisition
View item details in a requisition
Link a product from item_master to a purchase requisition by creating an item record

purchase_order.name: purchase_order
purchase_order.description: Used for managing purchase orders created from approved purchase requisitions
examples: Create a purchase order from approved requisition

purchase_order_item.name: purchase_order_item
purchase_order_item.description: Used for managing individual items in purchase orders. This links products from item_master to purchase orders with quantities and pricing.
examples: Add items to a purchase order

invoice.name: invoice
invoice.description: Used for managing supplier invoices and billing information
examples: View invoice totals and line items

invoice_item.name: invoice_item
invoice_item.description: Used for managing individual line items in invoices. This links products or services to invoices with quantities and pricing.
examples: Add line items to an invoice
Match invoice items to purchase orders

payment.name: payment
payment.description: Used for managing payments made to suppliers for invoices
examples: Record a payment for an invoice

receipt.name: receipt
receipt.description: Used for managing goods receipts and delivery confirmations

receipt_item.name: receipt_item
receipt_item.description: Used for managing individual items in receipts. This tracks what items were actually received.
examples: Add received items to a receipt

user.description: Used for managing system users and their roles
